Shoutout also to Tre Johnson, who had Zuby literally running down his back but never turned around to notice him.

quote.author: John Hollinger
quote.text: Deandre Ayton next Zuby Ejiofor as Ejiofor comes down with the rebound. Ejiofor then beat him down the floor by about 20 feet for an easy dunk. One of the most embarrassing plays of the season.
